description: Test probes — executable checks that verify invariants. Mix of happy path and deliberate breaks.

probes.name: happy-path-arithmetic
probes.description: Happy path: verify arithmetic on normal dataset

probes.name: approval-rate-formula-check
probes.description: Verify approval rate is calculated correctly (100 * approved / total)

probes.name: empty-result-consistency
probes.description: Edge case: no data in range → empty state
steps: Set date range to 2099-01-01 ... 2099-12-31 (future, no data)

assertions.textContent: No reports found | Empty | No data

probes.passCriteria: data-empty=true and user sees clear 'no data' message

probes.name: export-always-clickable
probes.description: Export button is ALWAYS clickable, even with 0 rows
steps: Set date range to future (no data)
probes.passCriteria: Button clickable, download proceeds with empty CSV

probes.name: deliberate-break-1-arithmetic-hardcoded
probes.description: DELIBERATE BREAK: hardcode total to wrong value, verify detection
probes.setup: Modify code: set data-value of total to '999' (wrong)
probes.expectedOutcome: Verification FAILS with 'arithmetic-sum violation: DOM 999 ≠ calc 287'
probes.notes: Tests that we catch hardcoded mistakes

probes.name: deliberate-break-2-contract-missing
probes.description: DELIBERATE BREAK: remove data-metric attribute (break contract)
probes.setup: Modify DOM: delete data-metric='approval-rate' and data-value attributes
probes.expectedOutcome: Verification FAILS with 'missing contract: data-metric=approval-rate not found'
probes.notes: App still renders fine (React doesn't break), but contract is broken. Catches silent failures.

probes.name: deliberate-break-3-verification-underspecified
probes.description: DELIBERATE BREAK: write weak verification that passes even when wrong
probes.setup: Write bad probe: only check that total > 0 (ignores calculation errors)

assertions.note: Probe passes but invariant is violated — bad verification

probes.expectedOutcome: Probe passes (wrong!). Upgrade to proper assertion: arithmetic-sum must hold.
probes.notes: Teaches: 'testing' != 'verifying'. Probes must check invariants explicitly.
